scope: CPU fault injection, actual child processes, regression contracts; no live training rerun
reviewed_paths: backend analysis -> append journal -> latest/investigation projection
wrapper -> workload and sidecar sessions -> shutdown/exit status

tdd.red: Three TERM-ignoring sidecars prevented workload exit. Two further cases left an exited leader child or actual FIFO-blocked analyzer alive. Two injected stale-PGID cases killed a foreign session.
tdd.change: Isolate sidecar sessions; allow controller cleanup, then bounded group escalation with inherited ownership verification.

tdd.red: Five cases left final investigation/latest projections missing after ENOSPC despite a committed report, including restart and isolated-worker preparation.
tdd.change: Repair derived files from the journal without backend queries or new revisions; retain provisional retry and immutable existing files.

tdd.red: Two cases lost the first rewritten record or emitted stale buffered content when the same inode regrew beyond the previous offset.
tdd.change: Compare a bounded consumed suffix against the descriptor before buffered reads; reopened contents retain backlog timestamp provenance.

tdd.red: Negative LOCAL_RANK escaped as IndexError; invalid/partial configuration plus unavailable stderr propagated warning failures.
tdd.change: Validate the GPU index lower bound and reuse best-effort warning handling in both factories; preserve explicit constructor errors and valid context.

validation.promtool: 3.5.0 enabled for real PromQL regression tests

follower_microbenchmark.method: 20,000 local JSONL records; follow mode; median of five runs; parsing only, not training throughput

limitations: Physical multi-node restart, network partition and shared filesystem failure were not exercised.
Actual VERL/vLLM training, Docker cgroup, 3FS and Ollama were not rerun.
Bounded suffix checking cannot recover already deleted unread records or detect every arbitrary file rewrite; rename rotation remains recommended.
SIGKILL cannot force completion of uninterruptible kernel I/O; orphan zombie reaping belongs to system init.
Final synchronous export/storage operations are not covered by a wrapper-wide wall-clock deadline.
